agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on 12 November 2026 in Finance and Corporate Services Committee Report 38.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Monday, 9 November 2026, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Tuesday, 10 November 2026.
agenda_items.minutes: These “Summary Minutes” indicate the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the full Minutes, such as the record of written and oral submissions. Recorded votes and dissents contained in the Summary Minutes are draft until the full Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Committee. The draft of the full Minutes (for confirmation) will be published with the agenda for the next regular Committee meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.

sub_agendas_items.title: Maple Grove Health Hub Request for Proposals

attachments.attachment_title: Report - Maple Grove Health Hub Request for Proposals.pdf

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation(s)
That the Finance and Corporate Services Committee recommend Council:

WHEREAS City Council approved a Primary Care Strategy in 2025 recognizing that access to primary health care is an important contributor to community health and well-being, economic competitiveness, workforce attraction and quality of life; and
WHEREAS approximately 19,000 residents in Stittsville and Kanata do not have access to an attached primary care clinician; and
WHEREAS, on October 22, 2025, Council directed staff to initiate a Request for Offers for the development of a health hub on the northern portion of the City-owned lands at 1655 Maple Grove Road, having identified the site as the preferred location for a primary care health hub serving Stittsville, Kanata and surrounding communities; and
WHEREAS staff subsequently issued RFP No. 39126-97173-P01 on August 5, 2026, seeking proposals for the transfer of the property at market value, and the single submission received did not meet the established criteria; and
WHEREAS the development of a primary care health hub would provide a significant public benefit and advance Council's strategic priorities relating to health, well-being and community development; and
WHEREAS the City of Ottawa’s Disposal of Real Property Policy provides that real property shall be disposed of at current market value (Section 1.2), and that City Council may, pursuant to Section 1.3, authorize the disposal of real property at less than market value, unless prohibited by theMunicipal Act, 2001, where Council is of the opinion that doing so is in the best interests of the City;
WHEREAS subsection 110(3) of theMunicipal Act, 2001and Ontario Regulation 603/06 provide a framework for municipalities to enter into municipal capital facilities agreements in respect of facilities used for the provision of health services, including the potential provision of municipal assistance in accordance with applicable legislative requirements;
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the recommendations in the report be replaced with the following:
